{{Top|leg}}
An '''exacta''' was a type of [[Gambling/Legends|bet]]. They were a riskier kind of bet, but the rewards were bigger. It involved not only predicting the winner of a race, but also predicting the second place. The racers had to finish in the same order specified on the bet for it to pay out.<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
